package logging
import "go.uber.org/zap"
func New() *zap.Logger { return zap.NewNop() }

type Logger struct{}
func (*Logger) Infow(string, ...any) {}
func (*Logger) Errorw(string, ...any) {}
func (*Logger) Debugw(string, ...any) {}
func (*Logger) Warnw(string, ...any) {}
func (l *Logger) With(...any) *Logger { return l }
